shortDescription: Manage Pi-hole DHCP server settings via Pi-hole v6 API

options.name: end
options.description: The end address of the DHCP range (e.g. 10.0.6.100). Required only when state=present.

options.name: ignore_unknown_clients
options.description: When True, Pi-hole DHCP grants addresses only to clients specifically defined in dhcp.hosts (static reservations). All other clients are ignored (but can still self-assign).

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Whether DHCPv6 (and RA) is active. Only useful if Pi-hole has an IPv6 address.

options.name: lease_time
options.description: DHCP lease time. Supports formats like '45m', '1h', '2d', '1w', 'infinite'. Leave empty to use Pi-hole’s default.

options.name: multi_dns
options.description: Advertise Pi-hole DNS multiple times to mitigate clients adding their own DNS servers.

options.name: netmask
options.description: Optional subnet mask in the format 255.255.255.0. Leave empty to let Pi-hole infer from the Pi-hole interface IP.

options.name: rapid_commit
options.description: Enables DHCPv4 rapid commit (faster address assignment). Only enable if Pi-hole is the sole DHCP server on this network.

options.name: router
options.description: The default gateway/router IP handed out to DHCP clients (e.g. 10.0.6.1). Required only when state=present.

options.name: start
options.description: The start address of the DHCP range (e.g. 10.0.6.50). Required only when state=present.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), enable DHCP (active = true) and configure DHCP settings. If C(absent), disable DHCP (active = false) and ignore other settings.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Pi-hole instance (e.g. https://pihole.example.com).
